train_acc_videox20_1.mp4.description: Rainy expressway: a white sedan with a smashed front is already stopped against the left guardrail and a worker in a hi-vis vest walks nearby with debris on the road; trucks pass by.

train_acc_video24.mp4.description: Two white cars side by side at an intersection: the SUV on the left turns/swerves right into the sedan, the two lock together, and the SUV is shoved to the left roadside while the sedan skids away in a cloud of dust. Replayed from a wider view starting ~6.4 s.

train_acc_video45_1.mp4.description: Night intersection: a black Mercedes running the red light from the right T-bones a white box truck crossing the junction; the truck spins and overturns, spilling cargo. The crash is shown again from a wide second camera (~8.1 s), then aftermath views.

train_acc_videox5_1.mp4.description: Overhead PTZ camera at an expressway gore area: a car already lies overturned beside the crash barrels with debris around and a traffic officer walking nearby; the camera then pans/zooms around the pole.

train_acc_video94.mp4.description: A dark sedan entering from the left edge strikes a cyclist riding into the frame; the cyclist is thrown and the bike lands on the road while the car stops.

train_acc_video111.mp4.description: On a highway a silver sedan catches up with a dark sedan and clips its left rear, then overturns and rolls across the median in a dust cloud, coming to rest upside down; the edited news clip repeats the crash many times in slow-motion close-ups and zoomed-out normal-speed replays.

train_acc_video174.mp4.description: A dark sedan loses control on the highway, veers right and smashes into the roadside guardrail end in a cloud of dust; the clip then replays the impact in a zoomed-in view and shows the driver standing by the wrecked car.

train_acc_videox3_9.mp4.description: Foggy night highway: an overturned truck lies against the right guardrail under a gantry with police cars and flashing lights already on scene; traffic passes slowly and no new collision occurs.

train_acc_video87.mp4.description: Night intersection: two electric scooters on crossing paths collide just beyond the crosswalk, riders and scooters slide across the road while a dark car following behind brakes and stops near them.

train_acc_video117.mp4.description: A white SUV turning left strikes the side of a passing minivan; the van is pushed into the median curb and flips over, rolling along the road. After a cut at ~3.9 s the van hitting the curb and rolling is replayed.

train_acc_video116.mp4.description: A motorcyclist crossing the road beyond the crosswalk is struck by a red car coming from the far side; rider and motorcycle are thrown and slide across the lanes. The impact is replayed at ~14 s.

train_acc_video108.mp4.description: Rainy intersection: a white car crossing from the left is T-boned by a black car speeding straight through; the black car spins away and overturns at the far right corner amid spray and debris, while the white car is knocked into the far crosswalk.

train_acc_video28.mp4.description: Edited highway clip following a white van (circled) that turns around/moves slowly among trucks: in the first two camera segments trucks brake hard and swerve past it (near misses), then in the third segment a yellow container truck runs into the van, spinning it, and skids to a stop in a cloud of dust.

train_acc_video7.mp4.description: A white box truck drifts left into the median guardrail on a curved highway; the cab separates from the cargo body and the wreck ends up across the lane. The crash is replayed at ~4.9 s, followed by aftermath footage of drivers rescuing the occupant.

train_acc_video74.mp4.description: Night intersection: an electric bike carrying a passenger runs a red light (circled in the first camera view); in the second camera view from ~2.3 s a dark car crossing on green hits it, throwing both riders onto the road.

train_acc_video151.mp4.description: A dark car drifts across the lanes toward the right median, hits the curb and planting strip, rides along it and overturns onto its roof, coming to rest in the lane. The very first frame (0.0 s) is a brief teaser still of the rollover.

train_acc_video147.mp4.description: At a junction on a tree-lined road a black sedan pulls out from the right side road into the path of a dark SUV; the SUV strikes it, rolls over, hits the roadside pole/trees and comes to rest on its roof; the rest of the clip is aftermath with passers-by.

train_acc_video176.mp4.description: Edited news clip: after an aftermath teaser, a circled view shows a silver car turning left across the path of a gold sedan going straight; they collide front-to-side in the intersection. The rest shows soldiers securing the scene from other angles.

train_acc_video192.mp4.description: A black SUV pulls out from roadside parking and cuts left into a white SUV, which is pushed into the median guardrail and overturns onto its side; the clip opens with a still of the overturned SUV and replays the crash from ~5.7 s.

train_acc_video11.mp4.description: A white SUV cuts late across the lane toward the exit gore in front of a red box truck; the truck clips its rear, spinning it into the crash cushion/guardrail at the gore. A zoomed-in replay of the impact follows from ~6 s.

train_acc_video125_1.mp4.description: Rainy mountain highway, far carriageway: a box truck (circled/arrowed, small in frame) skids on the wet road after braking and slams into the central median guardrail/hedge; the clip starts with a title card and ends with a close-up photo of the damaged truck.

train_acc_video29.mp4.description: Tunnel: a minivan suffers a tire blowout, swerves right then left and slams into the left tunnel wall, overturning several times; first seen far away from one camera (~6.75 s), then shown again from a closer second camera from ~11 s (wall impact ~13.55 s).

train_acc_video187.mp4.description: A red flatbed semi-truck cuts right across the gore area toward an exit and sideswipes a red car in the adjacent lane, dragging it along while crossing the chevrons before stopping at the exit; the same crash is shown again from a wide elevated camera (~13.2 s) and a closer framing of it (~22.7 s).

train_acc_video15.mp4.description: A white light truck turning left at a barrier-gate junction strikes a scooter rider coming from the left; the rider is dragged/thrown to the ground behind the truck, which stops a moment later.

train_acc_video96.mp4.description: Night street: a speeding car enters from the lower left, veers onto the sidewalk and ploughs into people/scooters at a roadside stall near the crosswalk, with sparks and debris; the scene then goes dark with a victim lying on the road.

train_acc_videox21_1.mp4.description: Highway aftermath: an overturned dark car against the median guardrail and a white sedan with a crushed front, with people standing around and a police pickup behind; the camera zooms out and traffic passes slowly, no new collision.

train_acc_video105.mp4.description: Rainy city street: a silver BMW pulls out from roadside parking and makes a U-turn/left turn across the road into the path of an oncoming scooter rider, who hits the car front and falls to the ground.

train_acc_video175.mp4.description: Far carriageway of a highway (small, zooming camera): a red medium truck loses control after scraping the median (per captions), tilts onto two wheels, crosses the lanes and overturns onto its side in the emergency lane against the guardrail. A second camera from ~19.6 s shows the preceding lane change by a semi-trailer but the contact is too far to see.

train_acc_video106.mp4.description: A white SUV slows for a pedestrian crossing the road (circled) and the following black SUV rear-ends it, pushing it forward with debris; a pickup then swerves around the scene. The clip opens with a 0.1 s still of the impact.

train_acc_video40.mp4.description: A dark sedan entering from the right in the wrong lane hits a white SUV head-on, then a following red car rear-ends the SUV, sending debris and the sedan spinning; a zoomed-in replay of the chain crash follows from ~11 s.

train_acc_video70.mp4.description: At an intersection a scooter rider (circled) crosses on the crosswalk from behind a stopped bus and is hit by a white hatchback going straight; the rider is thrown and the scooter slides across the junction.
